text.short: Alturas, Modoc County, on Lakeview Drive. Family style, five courses, a wood fire and a jukebox — and a Picon at the bar.
text.today: The furthest north-east room in this directory, a long way from any other. A regular names the french fries here as the best of any room in it.
text.table: Five courses before the entree: bread and butter, soup, salad, the day's dish, then what you ordered, with wine, coffee and ice cream after.

seating.note: Family style with the sides passed, by every account we read.

picon.note: Confirmed by a regular; the listings agree the bar makes a good one.

kin.how: five courses before the entree, and three after
family style, and a long way from anywhere
